trialWelcome.trialInfo: For the next 14 days, you have unlimited access to all features.
trialWelcome.centralBody: Trawlarr Central is the official platform for collecting logs and metrics from all your Trawlarr installations. Features include:

centralPoints.logs: Aggregate logs across servers in one place
centralPoints.grafana: Present metrics in Grafana with ready-to-use data sources
centralPoints.dashboards: Use the built-in dashboards for a simple overview

trialWelcome.supportBody: Check the docs for setup guides or join the community for help and tips.
trialWelcome.limitationsTitle: After the trial ends, some features are limited for non-supporters.
trialWelcome.limitationsBody: Trawlarr is free and open source, and supporters help keep the project healthy. Supporter status can be earned by contributing in many ways, including documentation or helping others in Discord. Financial support is not required. See the feature comparison for what supporter access unlocks.
trialWelcome.enjoy: We hope you enjoy using Trawlarr!
